node.title: Can i mange XML::LibXML to do an include? Or is there another XML module that does it?
node.author: Darkwing
node.doctext:
Hi Monks,

i use [mod://XML::LibXML] for several years. Actually, i wanted to read an xml file containing some xinclude statements. I expected XML::LibXML to perform the include, but it doesn't. Example:

XML file foo.xml:

XML file bar.xml: This is bar.xml!

Perl code: use strict; use warnings; use XML::LibXML; my $dom = XML::LibXML->load_xml(location => "foo.xml"); print $dom->toString(1);

The above perl script prints:

Obviously, the has not been executed. Is there a way to tell XML::LibXML to do an include? Or is there another XML module that does the job?
